placement.default: any free cell (floor pieces on floor cells, wall pieces on top-wall cells)
placement.mustTouchWall: pieces with info.mustTouchWall = true (the 2x1 folding screen) only go where the footprint's top row is row 1, against the top wall
placement.tint: random pieces: draw <id>, then <id>-tint multiplied by info.colour1, or by colour 2 = the drop floor's belt colour (beltStyles[belt].belt)

whiteBeltFallback.rule: on White-belt floors colour 2 is soft wood tan instead of the near-white belt colour

placement.parked: Tier 2+ named-monster gold-plate trophies are parked until Tier 2 is planned
